x: Mike Small will have something to think about in the Hammer with 22 year old Jimmy Summers who has thrown 55.74 - a club record will go there in 1988.
Individual wins were recorded by Marcus Adam in the sprints, Femi Abejide the Triple Jump, Marcello Bizio the Steeplechase and Jimmy Summers and Abi Ekoku mopping up the Throws.
Nigel Bevan was 2nd in the Javelin with a 70.42m throw and Jimmy Summers had a 54.58m Hammer Throw. Jimmy also teamed up with Bob Bridges to get valuable points in the Pole Vault.
Jimmy Summers would have none of it and proceeded to finish 4th in the A string and gained more points than in the Hammer! Match 3 Alexander Stadium Birmingham 15 July 1989
